chart.umd.min.js — Chart.js v4.5.1 UMD production build
Source: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/Chart.js/4.5.1/chart.umd.min.js
License: MIT
Vendored (not loaded from a CDN) so the Analytics screen's charts render
fully offline inside the Capacitor WebView. To upgrade, download a newer
chart.umd.min.js from the same source and replace this file.
